name: EPIC 220696594
description: A red giant in K2 campaign 8, 11.6 solar radii and 0.98 solar masses, weighed by its oscillations.

radius.source: Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_apo, EPIC 220696594 (K2 campaign 8): PARAM radius (solar radii) 11.557114 (16th-84th percentiles 11.142326-12.111225), MA09 pipeline with APOGEE DR17

text.card: A red giant 3,292 parsecs away, 12 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 8, give 0.98 solar masses and 11.6 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 4,816 K at its surface.
